methodology.title: How the NASCAR model works
methodology.body: Driver strength is modeled as a trajectory over recent finishes, track-type affinity (superspeedway, intermediate, short track, road course), and team/equipment form. A Monte Carlo simulation of the remaining schedule and the playoff elimination format produces championship probabilities, benchmarked against bookmaker lines race by race — the same predict → log publicly → grade loop as every sport on this platform.
